title: CHAPTER 2: SENSATION AND PERCEPTION
content:
ውድ የሀገሬ ልጆች እንዲሁም የEthioFresh ቤተሰቦች! 💖👋 እንደምን አላችሁ? ዛሬ የGeneral Psychology (Psyc 1011) Chapter 2 የመጨረሻ ክፍል የሆነውን Part 3 Tutorial ይዘንላችሁ መጥተናል። በዚህ ክፍል ስለ Depth Perception፣ Perceptual Constancies እና Illusions እናያለን። ፈተና ላይ በሚወጡ ትሪኮች እና አዝናኝ ምሳሌዎች አዘጋጅተነዋል።👇👇👇


2.3.3. Depth Perception

If we live in a two-dimensional world, form perception would be sufficient. But because we live in a three-dimensional world, we have evolved depth perception—the ability to judge the distance of objects. Given that images on the retina are two dimensional, how can we determine the distance of objects (the distal stimulus) from the pattern of stimulation on our retinas (the proximal stimulus)? Depth perception depends on the use of binocular cues and monocular cues.

A. Binocular Cues
These require the interaction of both eyes. There are two primary kinds:
1. Retinal Disparity: This is the degree of difference between the image of an object that is focused on the two retinas. The closer the object to your eyes, the greater the retinal disparity.
2. Convergence: The degree to which the eyes turn inward (towards the nose) to focus on an object. The closer the objects are, the greater the physical convergence of the eyes. Drinking alcohol impairs depth perception by disrupting this normal convergence mechanism.

👉 Depth Perception & Binocular Cues:
የምንኖረው 3D (Three-dimensional) በሆነ አለም ውስጥ ስለሆነ የነገሮችን ርቀት መለየት (Depth perception) ግዴታችን ነው። ይህንን ለማድረግ አእምሯችን ሁለት መንገዶችን ይጠቀማል። የመጀመሪያው Binocular Cues (የሁለት አይን ጥቆማዎች) ነው።
• Retinal Disparity: ሁለት አይኖቻችን ትንሽ ራቅ ብለው ስለሚገኙ፣ አንድን ነገር ሲያዩ ወደ ጭንቅላታችን የሚልኩት ምስል ትንሽ ይለያያል። ነገሩ ወደ አይናችን በተጠጋ ቁጥር ይሄ የሁለቱ ምስሎች ልዩነት (Disparity) ይጨምራል።
• Convergence: አንድን ነገር በቅርበት ስናይ፣ አይኖቻችን ወደ ውስጥ (ወደ አፍንጫችን) ይሰበሰባሉ። አልኮል ሲጠጣ ይሄ የዓይን መሰብሰብ (Convergence) ስለሚረበሽ ርቀትን በትክክል መገመት ይከብዳል።

😂 የሳይኮሎጂ ቀልድ ለፈገግታ: ማታ ጠጥቶ የሚገባ ሰው ለምንድነው ጉድጓድ የማይዘለው? ምክንያቱም አልኮል Convergenceን ስለሚያበላሸው፣ ጉድጓዱን እንደ ቅርብ አድርጎ ስለሚያየው ሳይዘል ይገባበታል! 😂

B. Monocular Cues
These require only one eye. Even people who have lost sight in one eye may still possess excellent depth perception.
1. Accommodation: The change in the shape of the eye's lens that lets you focus the image of an object on the retina. The greater the accommodation required, the closer the object.
2. Motion Parallax: The perceptual tendency to perceive ourselves as passing objects faster when they are closer to us than when they are farther away. (e.g., Driving and passing nearby telephone poles much faster than a distant farmhouse).
3. Pictorial Cues: Formalized by Leonardo da Vinci 500 years ago to create realistic depth in two-dimensional paintings:
  • Interposition: An object that partially overlaps another object will appear closer.
  • Relative Size: If two people are known to be the same height, the one casting a smaller retinal image is perceived as farther away.
  • Linear Perspective: Parallel lines (like railroad tracks) seem to converge as they recede into the distance. Taking advantage of this solved WWII naval airplane crashes by utilizing two distinct taillights.
  • Elevation: Objects placed higher in your visual field seem farther away.
  • Shading Patterns: Areas in shadow tend to recede, while brightly illuminated areas stand out forward.
  • Aerial Perspective: Closer objects seem clearer and sharper, whereas distant objects look hazier due to atmospheric interference.
  • Texture Gradient: The nearer an object is, the clearer and more detailed its surface texture appears.

Visual Aid 1: Linear Perspective & Interposition
    Linear Perspective               Interposition
       /          \                     +-------+
      /   (Far)    \                    |       |
     /     ||       \                   |   A   |____
    /      ||        \                  |  (Front)   |
   /       ||         \                 +---|   B    |
  /     (Near)         \                    | (Back) |
 /                      \                   +--------+
[Parallel lines converge]            [Object A overlaps B]

👉 Monocular Cues - የአንድ አይን ጥቆማዎች:
እነዚህ ደግሞ በአንድ አይን ብቻ ርቀትን የምናውቅባቸው መንገዶች ናቸው።
• Accommodation: የአይናችን ሌንስ ቅርፁን በመቀየር ምስልን የማጥራት ሂደት ነው።
• Motion Parallax: በመኪና እየሄድን የቅርብ ነገሮች (ለምሳሌ ዛፎች) ቶሎ ወደ ኋላ ሲሮጡ፣ የራቁት ደግሞ ቀስ ብለው የሚሄዱ የሚመስለን ክስተት ነው።
• Pictorial Cues: ሰአሊዎች ምስልን እውነተኛ (Realistic) ለማስመሰል የሚጠቀሙባቸው ናቸው። አንዱ ምስል ሌላውን ከጋረደው (Interposition) የጋረደው ቅርብ እንደሆነ እናውቃለን። የባቡር ሀዲድ መስመሮች እየራቅናቸው ስንሄድ ከርቀት የምናያቸው ሁለቱ ትይዩ መስመሮች የተገናኙ የሚመስሉን ደግሞ Linear Perspective ይባላል።

💡 Exam Hint: ፈተና ላይ የሁለተኛው የአለም ጦርነት አውሮፕላኖች ችግር (WWII naval airplane crashes) በምን ተፈታ ከተባላችሁ፣ መልሱ Linear perspectiveን ተጠቅመው ሁለት የጅራት መብራት (Two taillights) በማድረግ ነው።


2.3.4. Perceptual Constancies

The image of an object focused on your retina may vary constantly in size, shape, and brightness depending on distance and lighting conditions. Yet you continue to perceive the object as stable and unchanging. This capacity is adaptive and provides us with a visual stability of the physical world.

1. Size Constancy: Makes you interpret a change in retinal image size as a change in distance rather than an actual change in the physical size of the object. Disruption of size constancy by alcohol intoxication is one primary way drinking promotes automobile accidents (underestimating vehicle sizes and distances).
2. Shape Constancy: Assures that an object of known shape will appear to maintain its normal structure regardless of the angle from which you view it. This occurs because your brain automatically compensates for the slant or viewing position of an object.
3. Brightness Constancy: Though the actual amount of light reflected off an object can vary drastically, we perceive the object as maintaining a constant level of brightness.

Visual Aid 2: Shape Constancy Concept
   [Door Closed]        [Door Ajar]        [Door Open]
   +-----------+       +---------/        +--------/
   |           |       |        /         |       /
   |           |  -->  |       /   -->    |      /
   |           |       |      /           |     /
   +-----------+       +-----/            +----/
   (Rectangle)         (Trapezoid)        (Line/Slant)
   [Perceived constantly as a Rectangular Door by the brain]

👉 Perceptual Constancies:
አይናችን ላይ የሚያርፈው የነገሮች ምስል በቅርፅ፣ በመጠን እና በብሩህነት ቢለዋወጥም፣ አእምሯችን ግን ነገሮቹን "አልተለወጡም፣ ትክክለኛ መጠናቸው ያው ነው" ብሎ ይረዳል።
• Size Constancy: ጓደኛችሁ እየራቀ ሲሄድ አይናችሁ ላይ የሚያርፈው ምስሉ እያነሰ ቢሄድም፣ አእምሯችሁ ግን "ጓደኛዬ አጭር እየሆነ ሳይሆን እየራቀ ነው" ብሎ ይረዳል። አልኮል ይህንን ሲያዛባው መኪና አደጋ ይፈጠራል (የመኪናን ትልቅነት አሳንሶ ስለሚያሳይ)።
• Shape Constancy: በር ከፍተን በጎን ስናየው አራት ማዕዘንነቱ የተዛባ ቢመስልም፣ አእምሯችን ግን በሩ አራት ማዕዘን መሆኑን ጠንቅቆ ያውቃል።

🤔 Case Question:
A student looks at a white paper under a very dim light and still identifies it as 'white' rather than grey. Which constancy is at work here?

Answer: Brightness Constancy.


2.3.5. Perceptual Illusion

Visual illusions provide valuable clues to the cognitive processes involved in normal visual perception. Illusions often occur due to the misapplication of a visual cue (such as size constancy).
• Edgar Allan Poe's “The Sphinx”: A man perceives a monstrous, terrifying animal on a distant mountain, but it was actually a tiny insect climbing on his window pane. Because he perceived it as being far away on the mountain, his brain assumed it was massive (a direct misapplication of size constancy).
• Moon Illusion: The moon appears significantly larger when it sits near the horizon than when it is high overhead. This is a pure illusion because both the actual distance and retinal image size remain identical in both positions.
• Müller-Lyer Illusion: Two lines of equal physical length appear dramatically different in size. The favored psychological explanation relies on size constancy cues and the resemblance of the arrows to the inside corner of a room vs. the outside corner of a building.

Visual Aid 3: Müller-Lyer Illusion
Line A (Appears Shorter):  <------->
Line B (Appears Longer):   >-------<
[Both horizontal lines are equal in physical length!]

Extra Sensory Perception (ESP):
Some people appear to possess an ability to gain knowledge about other people, distant objects, or future events without any direct sensory contact. This phenomenon is known as ESP or paranormal ability.

👉 Perceptual Illusion - የዕይታ ማታለል:
አንዳንድ ጊዜ አእምሯችን መረጃዎችን በተሳሳተ መንገድ ተረድቶ የሌለን ነገር እንዳለ አድርጎ ያያል (Illusion)።
• The Sphinx Example: በመስኮት ላይ ያለች ትንሽ ነፍሳት፣ ሩቅ ተራራ ላይ ያለች ትልቅ ጭራቅ መስላ መታየቷ የSize constancy በተሳሳተ መንገድ መተግበር ውጤት ነው።
• Moon Illusion: ጨረቃ አድማስ ላይ ስትሆን ትልቅ፣ አናታችን ላይ ስትሆን ደግሞ ትንሽ የምትመስልበት ማታለያ ነው። መጠኗ ግን በሁለቱም ቦታ አንድ ነው።
• ESP (Extra Sensory Perception): ሰዎች ምንም አይነት የህዋሳት ንክኪ (ማየት፣ መስማት...) ሳይኖራቸው ስለሌሎች ሰዎች ወይም ክስተቶች የሚያውቁበት (Paranormal) ችሎታ ነው።
